full_prompt: Edit the supplied 144 v6 triptych, preserving its confirmed warm softly rendered 3D owl-pet concept style, three birds, composition, forest branch, supported feet and labels. PRIMARY CORRECTION ONLY: both adults' cheek/auricular extensions must look like soft fine feather filaments integrated into the rounded cheek contour, not long rigid porcupine quills, whisker fans, or sideways hair spikes. Use the Figure 6b Mindanao bird photograph on the accompanying scientific plate as a qualitative contour reference ONLY (top centre panel b); the plate's other birds are DIFFERENT species, don't copy them. Preserve spotted adult crowns, mixed streaks/bars breast and longitudinal irregular belly marks, yellow eyes, olive-yellow bills and yellow feet with dark claw tips. Keep the central older immature plain crown, closed eyes and two feet on branch; do not introduce neonatal down or flying poses. Male/female are design slots with equal nominal scale; do not imply proved dimorphism.
